name: Non-Negative Roots Polynomial Obfuscation
description: Replaced the original edge and vertex energy formulas with a single, symmetric, degree-5 polynomial for edge coupling that evaluates to 0 if and only if the states are different, and strictly positive otherwise. The target energy is set to 0, which logically enforces proper 3-coloring without any false positives, whilst completely destroying the specific numeric constants (-4m) and algebraic structures that models were pattern-matching.
